description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.117 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Returns top stock holdings from any institution's latest SEC 13F filing. Input: institution name (e.g. 'Renaissance Technologies', 'Bridgewater Associates'). Output: top 25 positions by market value with shares, value, and portfolio weight. No API key. SEC EDGAR source. $0.117/call.
